# Layout contract (fixture)

The presented UI that `LayoutAudit.checkPresented` opens in the fixture's `-presented` screen.

## Presented UI

| Element | Opened from | Kind | Size | At the minimum size |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Actions menu | Presented screen, `actions` | menu | 2 items | inside the window |
| Track details | Presented screen, `more` | popover | 100x60 | inside the window |
| Sort list | Presented screen, `sort` | dropdown built in the window | 160 wide | under its button, inside the window |
| Export menu | Presented screen, `export` | menu | 2 items | inside the window |
| Help tooltip | Presented screen, the help button | tooltip | system | not opened: no identifier |
